summary: Iteration 5 backend testing for Neural: POST /api/analysis/quick/{kind} converted to fire-and-forget background-job. Verified POST returns {job_id, status:'running', kind} in <5s, disclaimer/plan/watchlist gates short-circuit BEFORE job creation (no job_id leaked), GET /analysis/quick/jobs/{job_id} returns proper shape with user_id + _id scrubbed, cross-user isolation returns 404, and completed jobs reach status='done' with correct result shape. All 13 iteration-5 tests pass (when bg tasks don't saturate the event loop). Iteration-4 disclaimer regression: 12/15 pass — 3 failures are from tests that still expect the OLD synchronous quick_analyze response shape (KeyError 'analyzed'/'results'), i.e. test-code needs updating, NOT a product regression. Iteration 1-3 regression: 80/84 pass — same pattern (1 test expects old sync shape, 2 ReadTimeouts from ingress while bg job busy, 1 flaky admin-list assertion). Primary success criterion met: POST /analysis/quick/top returns 200 in <5s — the iteration-4 goal (avoid 60s ingress timeout) is achieved.

minor.issue: The bg task in _run_quick_job saturates the event loop while running. Concurrent requests (auth, watchlist, disclaimer GET) return ReadTimeout or ingress 502 for ~30-60s. Likely cause: create_analysis() makes Claude/LLM calls that block the event loop (synchronous HTTP client inside or sync-sleep) — running 3 in parallel overloads uvicorn's single worker. Reproduction: kick 2-3 quick-top jobs across different users back-to-back → subsequent /auth/login, /watchlist, /disclaimer/accept time out until jobs finish. FIX options: (a) run bg workers in a separate ProcessPoolExecutor/thread pool, (b) ensure anthropic client is truly async (httpx-based), (c) use motor's io_loop but run compute-heavy work via run_in_executor.

backend_test.py::TestAnalysis::test_quick_top and test_iteration4.py::TestQuickAnalyzeSummary::{test_pro_accepted_quick_top_returns_summary_shape, test_timeout_results_have_proper_shape} still expect old shape {analyzed, results, summary}. Since iteration 5 changed POST response to {job_id, status, kind}, these tests KeyError on 'analyzed'/'results'. Update these tests or delete them — iteration-5 suite covers the new shape.
(Carryover from iteration 3) Endpoint is still public despite spec saying 'auth required'. Not re-verified this run; assumed unchanged.

action_items: Investigate event-loop blocking in _run_quick_job → create_analysis. When 2-3 bg jobs run concurrently, ingress returns 502 and reads time out for other clients. Move LLM calls off event loop (anyio.to_thread.run_sync or process pool).

Retire or update legacy test_quick_top tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py::TestQuickAnalyzeSummary — they assert the old synchronous shape and now KeyError.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/analysis/quick/{kind} correctly raises 428 → 402 → 400 (empty watchlist) → 200 with job_id. Gate ordering is right: require_accepted(user) runs BEFORE plan_for(user) BEFORE watchlist.count_documents. Verified in code and behavior.

asyncio.create_task(_run_quick_job(...)) without a strong ref — in FastAPI with uvicorn this survives only if nothing garbage-collects it before it starts. Consider using a module-level set of tasks: BG = set(); task = asyncio.create_task(...); BG.add(task); task.add_done_callback(BG.discard). Minor robustness nit.

GET /analysis/quick/jobs/{job_id} filter is {'id':..., 'user_id':...} with projection {'_id':0,'user_id':0} — correct cross-user isolation (returns 404 for other users' jobs) and scrubs both mongo _id and internal user_id. Verified.

_run_quick_job handles HTTPException from create_analysis distinctly (adds status_code) vs generic Exception (just stores str). Timeout entries set status='timeout' with 90s message. Result shape matches spec.
On job failure (outer try/except), final doc sets status='failed' with error string. Not tested live (didn't have an easy way to induce a top-level exception), but code is straightforward.

QUICK_PER_TASK_TIMEOUT=90s is a generous per-task cap. Off the ingress critical path so a 90s LLM call is fine for user experience, BUT see the event-loop-saturation concern above — 90s of blocking = 90s of degraded service for everyone.
No cleanup of old quick_jobs documents — will accumulate forever. Consider a TTL index on started_at (e.g., 7 days).
No job cancellation endpoint — once started, a client cannot stop a job. Acceptable for MVP.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary iteration-5 suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py. Run with: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py -v`. Tests may fail when run back-to-back due to event-loop saturation from bg tasks — in that case, restart backend (`sudo supervisorctl restart backend`) between test classes, or run TestQuickJobPolling tests individually. The three known legacy-shape failures in backend_test.py (test_quick_top) and test_iteration4.py (TestQuickAnalyzeSummary) should be updated/deleted by main agent. BG task saturating the event loop is the single most important finding to surface — POST returns fast (goal achieved) but running bg job degrades other endpoints for 30-90s.
rca of the issue: Event-loop saturation during bg job: uvicorn runs a single asyncio loop; _run_quick_job uses asyncio.create_task but the underlying create_analysis calls into an LLM client that is NOT fully async (or the LLM wait is CPU-heavy JSON parsing). With asyncio.wait returning after ALL 3 complete (up to 90s), the loop is blocked for that whole window → ingress 502/504 and 30-60s ReadTimeouts for all other endpoints. Fix: wrap the blocking sections in anyio.to_thread.run_sync(...) or move to a ProcessPoolExecutor. Reproduction: POST /api/analysis/quick/top twice within 5s → observe subsequent /api/auth/login taking 30+ seconds or timing out.
